title: Updates on Safety and Security Preparations
what_it_is: Updates on Safety and Security Preparations

sections.label: Safety and security preparations update
sections.summary: A Member asked the Minister for Home Affairs for an update on safety and security preparations, citing SG Secure and recent terrorism-related attacks worldwide.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Fatimah Lateef
sentences.text: asked	the Minister for Home Affairs whether he can provide an update on how our safety and security preparations have measured up thus far, bearing in mind the Ministry's recent SG Secure initiative and lessons noted from the recent terrorism-related attacks around the world.

sections.label: Planned rocket attack on Marina Bay
sections.summary: The group was planning a rocket attack on Marina Bay from Batam.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The group was planning a rocket attack on Marina Bay from Batam.

sections.label: Expanded CCTV and Police Cameras
sections.summary: Security vigilance was enhanced by expanding CCTV coverage, with 62,000 Police Cameras installed in HDB blocks by June 2016 and about 11,000 more to follow.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: First, we have substantially enhanced our security vigilance by expanding our closed-circuit television (CCTV) coverage.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: We completed the installation of Police Cameras (PolCam) 1.0 in June 2016 with 62,000 cameras in all 10,000 Housing and Development Board (HDB) resident blocks.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: About 11,000 more cameras will be progressively installed over the next few years to cover public areas in our neighbourhoods and town centres.

sections.label: Home Team community advisories and applications
sections.summary: The Home Team developed advisories and applications to prepare the community for an attack, including Run Hide Tell, the 71999 SMS platform, i-Witness, Improvised First Aid Skills and the SG Secure E-learning package.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The Home Team has also developed advisories and applications to equip and prepare our community in the event of an attack.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: These include: (a) the "Run, Hide, Tell" advisory which guides the public on how to respond when an attack occurs; (b) the new 71999 SMS platform to allow the public to report an incident to the Police if they feel it is not safe for them to talk during an emergency; (c) the Police@SG App's i-Witness function which enables users to point, shoot and send critical information on major incidents and crime to support Police's investigations; (d) the "Improvised First Aid Skills" advisory which teaches the public how to use everyday items to help administer first aid to injured persons in the event of an attack; and (e) the SG Secure E-learning package which allows the public to carry out e-learning at their own pace and pick up useful survival skills to stay vigilant, cohesive and resilient.

sections.label: Solo radicalisation and SGSecure national movement
sections.summary: The Minister noted attacks take coordinated and solo forms, said the Home Team studies recent attacks, and stressed SGSecure must be a national movement, not solely by security forces.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: People, perhaps, who seemingly have very little communication with other organised groups being radicalised and then taking action on their own.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: So, whilst the Member speaks of coordinated attacks in multiple locations, we are also mindful that such attacks have taken various forms – both coordinated and solo – and we need to be prepared for all eventualities.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: So, in terms of the Home Team's response, I have articulated them as broadly as I could without going into too much operational details, but I assure the Member that the nature of recent attacks is being studied and being prepared for by the Home Team.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Coming to the Member's second point, it just underscores how important it is for the fight against terrorism for SGSecure to be a national movement and not be one undertaken solely by security forces because, in terms of detection, dealing with the attack as it happens and unfolds, and addressing the aftermath – both the loss of lives as well as the loss of social cohesion – all these require society to be on board to appreciate in a deeper fashion the importance of social harmony and the importance of our multicultural and multi-religious fabric.

sections.label: Cooperation with Malaysia and Indonesia
sections.summary: With key security ministers of Malaysia and Indonesia, they discussed strengthening international cooperation, including sharing biometric information of known and suspected militants.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: With the key security ministers of Malaysia and Indonesia, they spoke about how they can strengthen international cooperation, including the sharing of biometric information of known militants as well as those suspected of such activities, so that we can cooperate more closely among our countries.

sections.label: PolCam 2.0 camera expansion
sections.summary: Police are expanding PolCam 2.0 cameras to public areas in town centres, neighbourhood centres, hawker centres and linkways to transport nodes, having launched at three sites in Ang Mo Kio, Bedok and Jurong Gateway.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Under PolCam 2.0, Police are now expanding the installation of cameras to public areas in town centres, neighbourhood centres, hawker centres and linkways leading to transportation nodes, such as Mass Rapid Transit stations and bus interchanges.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: And I said earlier that we have already launched and rolled it out at three sites in Ang Mo Kio, Bedok and Jurong Gateway.
